name: script/backup
title: Verified dated backup
summary: Dated tar backup of a folder with a verification step; lists old backups instead of removing them.
when: Use when the user wants a dated copy of a folder kept elsewhere without any risk of losing files.

source.about: Folder that gets backed up; may use $HOME.

target.about: Folder that holds the archives; may use $HOME. It must exist already.

next: Write every file under files/ into the user's project, set source and target to the user's folders, then run ./backup.sh and show the archive path it prints.
